unit.label: Typhoons & comparisons
unit.title: Typhoons and Comparisons
unit.description: Discuss typhoons, give caution, compare conditions with 更 and 沒有…那麼, and complete the cumulative weather capstone.

goal.text: 希望這次的沒有上次的那麼可怕。
goal.pinyin: Xīwàng zhè cì de méiyǒu shàng cì de nàme kěpà.
goal.meaning: I hope this one isn't as scary as the last one.

steps.prompt: 傘 means…
steps.explanation: 傘 means umbrella.

steps.prompt: Which translation best matches 你怎麼沒帶傘呢？
options: How come you didn't bring an umbrella?
How long did you have an umbrella?
Is the umbrella bigger than last time?
steps.answer: How come you didn't bring an umbrella?
steps.explanation: The whole question is understood contextually; 呢 remains comprehension-only and is not generalized into a new rule.

steps.prompt: What happened today?
options: The speaker forgot to bring the umbrella today.
The speaker forgot it yesterday but brought it today.
The speaker did not bring an umbrella on either day.
steps.answer: The speaker forgot to bring the umbrella today.
steps.explanation: 今天忘了帶 means “forgot to bring it today.”

steps.prompt: What object do you hear?
steps.explanation: The audio asks about an umbrella.

lessons.title: A Typhoon Is Coming
lessons.subtitle: Talk about typhoons and retrieve imminence.

steps.prompt: 颱風 means…
steps.explanation: 颱風 means typhoon.

steps.prompt: What does 颱風快要來了 mean?
options: A typhoon is about to come.
The rain is about to stop.
steps.answer: A typhoon is about to come.
steps.explanation: 快要…了 marks an imminent event; 颱風 is the event that is about to arrive.

steps.prompt: In the historical typhoon summary above, what forecast window is mentioned?
steps.explanation: the historical summary states a four-hour forecast window.

steps.prompt: In the historical typhoon summary above, where was typhoon-day decision-making later vested?
steps.explanation: The historical summary says the decision was later vested in regional governments. The culture card already frames this as historical context, not current instructions.

steps.prompt: What is about to come?
steps.explanation: The audio says 颱風, “typhoon.”

steps.prompt: 討厭 means…

steps.prompt: In 哪裡都濕濕的, what does 濕濕的 describe?
steps.explanation: 濕濕的 is the attested here reduplicated description of a wet condition.

lessons.title: News and Take Care

options: it tells people to be more/extra careful
it marks a large quantity before a noun
it turns the clause into a comparison question
steps.answer: it tells people to be more/extra careful

lessons.title: This Time Is Even Bigger
lessons.subtitle: Use 更 as 'even more' inside comparison.

steps.prompt: 這次 means…
steps.explanation: 這次 means this time.

steps.prompt: 上次 means…
steps.explanation: 上次 means last time.

steps.prompt: In 星期天我更忙, 更 means…
steps.explanation: 更 adds an “even more” baseline.

steps.prompt: Which means “This year is even colder than last year”?
steps.explanation: 比…更… gives the “even more” comparison.

steps.prompt: Why is 更 not just a neutral “more” here?
steps.explanation: The source's “even more” value is part of 更 comparison.

steps.audioText: 這次的颱風會比上次的更大。
steps.prompt: Which comparison chunk do you hear?
steps.explanation: The audio uses 比上次的更大, “even bigger than last time.”

lessons.title: Not as Scary — Take Care
lessons.subtitle: Use 沒有…那麼 and close the typhoon dialogue.

steps.prompt: 可怕 means…
steps.explanation: 可怕 means scary.

steps.prompt: In this lesson, 慢走 is best understood as…
options: a command that only means walk slowly
steps.explanation: This is the pragmatic value.

steps.prompt: Which says the train is not as fast as the HSR?
steps.explanation: 沒有…那麼… expresses lower degree.

steps.prompt: Which set gives equal degree, lower degree, and higher degree in that order?
options: 跟…一樣 / 沒有…那麼 / 比
比 / 跟…一樣 / 沒有…那麼
沒有…那麼 / 比 / 跟…一樣

steps.explanation: 跟…一樣 gives equality, 沒有…那麼 gives lower degree, and 比 gives higher degree.

steps.prompt: What can 今天有沒有昨天熱？ imply?

steps.prompt: Which line is the conventional leave-taking/care formula?
steps.explanation: 小心慢走 closes the interaction.

steps.prompt: Which comparison phrase do you hear?
steps.explanation: The audio says this one is not as scary as the last one.

u44-even-more.title: Comparison with 更 — even more
u44-even-more.pattern: A + 比 + B + 更 + State Verb
u44-even-more.explanation: 更 means “even more” relative to an established or understood baseline. It goes before a state verb. this lesson first shows the baseline meaning in 星期天我更忙, then uses 更 inside 比 comparisons. Do not flatten 更 to neutral “more”; the “even more” baseline is part of the meaning. Confirmation questions can use 是不是.

examples.meaning: I am even busier on Sunday.
This year is even colder than last year.

examples.text: 這次的颱風是不是比上次的更大？
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de táifēng shì bú shì bǐ shàng cì de gèng dà?
examples.meaning: Is this typhoon even bigger than the last one?

u44-even-more.remember: 更 = even more relative to a baseline. In the this lesson comparison: A 比 B 更 + property.

u44-not-as.title: Not as…as with 沒有
u44-not-as.pattern: A + 沒有 + B + 那麼／這麼 + State Verb
u44-not-as.explanation: Use 沒有…那麼／這麼… to say A has a lower degree of a property than B: A is not as X as B. 那麼/這麼 may sometimes be omitted. The pattern notes that the positive form A 有 B 那麼／這麼 + State Verb is rare except in 嗎 questions. Questions can use 有沒有. Keep this distinct from earlier 不比. The source explicitly contrasts equality 跟…一樣, inferiority 沒有…那麼, and superiority 比.

examples.meaning: The train is not as fast as the HSR.

u44-culture-note.note: Historical context only, not current advice: this lesson summarizes an older typhoon-day system that used average wind class 7 or higher or gusts class 10 or higher, a forecast window of the next four hours, and suspension of school/work until the storm passed. Decision-making was once assigned to the Directorate-General of Personnel Administration using weather forecasts and local input, and was later vested in regional governments. Do not treat this as current 2026 procedure.
